remaining_material_limits: Original-controller MDIO timeout and error behavior is not hardware qualified. Native1ms poll backoff and10/20second stage deadlines require original/native timing comparison.

Local generation is not an invented wire nonce. Drained queues, endpoint reset and current peer/interface plus strict sequence are necessary; complete wire freshness still needs original trace evidence.
ROM zero-checksum receive policy is deliberately stricter than the old optional-checksum path and needs actual endpoint qualification.
Unknown configuration trailer, ROM tail and execute acknowledgement are not guessed. Current runtime cannot complete a DSL boot or automatic PPP login.
Kernel compilation-unit success does not substitute module linking/loading, device ownership or tested teardown/restore.
